claim: Official Hiša Franko rooms policy: dining guests only, one-night max, check-in 16:00–22:00, check-out 11:00, breakfast 8–10, all rooms have AC, no TVs.
quote: Our guesthouse is reserved exclusively for guests dining at the restaurant and can be booked for one night only when making your reservation.

claim: Hiša Franko sits in an old farmhouse 3 km west of Kobarid in Staro Selo and offers 10 rooms plus a 4-room depandance — 28 beds total.
quote: Hiša Franko is located in an old farmhouse 3km west of Kobarid in Staro Selo … 10 rooms plus a depandance with 4 rooms, total 28 beds.

claim: Hiša Franko Inn rates 4.3/5 from 135 Tripadvisor reviews; one guest cites €165/night with breakfast; reviewers say staying is necessary to enjoy dinner fully.
quote: Overall Rating: 4.3 of 5 bubbles (135 reviews) … 'a very reasonable price' at 165 euros for room and breakfast after dinner.

claim: Hiša Franko FAQ: Kobarid bus station is 3 km away; on-demand taxi service is available throughout the Soča Valley; no shuttle is provided.
quote: Kobarid bus station, 3 km from Hiša Franko … On-demand taxi service available throughout the Soča Valley.

claim: Apartment Žonir is at Staro selo 57, sleeps up to 4, has private sauna and large terrace, costs €75–155/night; breakfast is delivered to the apartment at extra cost; Hiša Franko is 'just a few steps' away.
quote: Just a few steps from the chalet, there is world-famous restaurant Hiša Franko … €75-155 per night.

claim: Chalet and Apartment Žonir with Sauna rates 8.7/10 on Booking.com; guests confirm it is 'within walking distance of a Michelin-starred restaurant'.
quote: rated 8.7 by recent guests … well-equipped, clean, and within walking distance of a Michelin-starred restaurant

claim: VisitSoča Kobarid operates Apartments Hlapi with SPA (Trg Svobode 14, Kobarid centre), Chalet & Apartment Žonir with Sauna (Staro selo 57), Apartment Honey Bee (Markova 18) and a transfer taxi.
quote: Apartments Hlapi with SPA — Trg Svobode 14, 5222 Kobarid … Chalet Žonir / Apartment Žonir — Staro selo 57 … Transfer Taxi VisitSoča Kobarid.

claim: First-person diner: on-site rooms were already full when the dining reservation was secured; the Žonir host drove guests to and from Hiša Franko at no extra charge.
quote: he drove us to and from Hisa Franko at no extra charge.

claim: Walking distance Kobarid centre → Staro Selo is roughly 4.4 km / ~53 min; the Nomago bus runs four times daily on weekdays for €3 (5 min); taxi is €14–18.
quote: Walking … 4.4 km, ~53 min … Nomago bus four times a day on weekdays, €3 … Taxi €14–18.

claim: A lime-tree avenue planted in 1936 lines the road between Kobarid and Staro Selo — the scenic route for the walk.
quote: The Lime Avenue was planted in year 1936 … between Kobarid and Staro Selo.

claim: Staro Selo is a hamlet of a few dozen houses; 2002 population was 153; church dedicated to St. Leonard.
quote: Saint Leonard's Church … 2002 data, the village had a population of 153 residents.

claim: Nebesa is a four-chalet retreat on a mountain plateau above Livek, built by Ana Roš's parents Katja and Bojan.
quote: four luxury chalets sit high on a mountain plateau overlooking the village of Livek

claim: Nebesa is 7 km from Kobarid; meals from partner restaurant Hiša Franko can be delivered to the chalet.
quote: nearest town is Kobarid, 7 km from Nebesa … Meals from the partner restaurant Hiša Franko … can be delivered to the property.

claim: Tripadvisor's 'closest hotels to Hiša Franko' list: Apartments Pri Nas 2.0 mi (4.6/5), Apartments Masera 2.1 mi (4.7/5), Gostišče Jazbec 2.7 mi (4.5/5), Tourist Farmhouse Kranjc 4.0 mi (4.9/5), Nebesa 4.5 mi (4.9/5).
quote: Apartments Pri Nas, Kobarid — 2.0 miles | 4.6/5 … Nebesa — 4.5 miles | 4.9/5

claim: Hisa Rejmr is a renovated 2-bedroom holiday home in central Kobarid rated 9.7/10 on Booking.com, with breakfast available.
quote: Hisa Rejmr is rated 9.7 by recent guests … 2 bedrooms, a living room, a fully equipped kitchen

claim: Hotel Hvala (Topli Val) is a family-run hotel 142 m from the centre of Kobarid.
quote: Hotel Hvala is a family-run hotel located just 142 meters from the center of Kobarid.

claim: Discover Soča Valley taxi will collect diners, wait through the 3–4 hour meal and return them to their accommodation.
quote: taxi drivers will wait for you until you finish your meal (usually 3-4 hours) and drive you back to your accommodation

claim: Hiša Franko, run by chef Ana Roš in Staro Selo near Kobarid, holds three Michelin stars and a Green Star.
quote: 3-Star Michelin Restaurant by Ana Roš | Hiša Franko
